corpusFingerprintMeaning: Canonical digest of frozen old/new normalized corpus digests; splitSha256 identifies the entire frozen expanded plan.

protocol.averaging: Macro: each tested journal equally; micro: each untouched held-out paper equally.
protocol.denominator: Full catalog; unsupported labels, unembeddable papers and abstentions count as misses.
protocol.historicalTestRole: Regression-only; excluded from main metrics and quality gate.

coverage.actualTestFractionDenominator: New unseen eligible components before temporal-boundary quarantine

newAcquisition.holdoutUniverse: The untouched holdout measures newly unseen papers within this bounded all-rights acquisition universe, not all publication output. Holdout membership is frozen before development reuse-rights filtering; acquisition eligibility still limits the evaluated population.
newAcquisition.articleTypePolicy: The acquisition query excludes indexed Editorial, Letter, Comment, Published Erratum, Retracted Publication, Retraction of Publication, Preprint and Expression of Concern types. Research is a broad bibliographic class, not an independently verified original-research assessment.

samplingStrategy.historicalCorpus: Previously seen, varied-license corpus; historical inspected test is reported separately as regression only.

previousCorpus.protocol: Retained historical sources include the original bounded varied-license corpus and the prior expanded OPEN_ACCESS:Y acquisition: English research/review papers, up to 1000 newest papers per journal per year in 2021-2026. These are earlier source protocols, not the new acquisition settings.
previousCorpus.retention: Eligible licensed historical training records remain in the fitting pool. New acquisition extends rather than replaces that pool; earlier validation, test and quarantined components remain excluded from development.

samplingStrategy.reuse: OA status and author attribution do not establish reuse rights. Documentary CC BY, CC0 or public-domain permission is separately required for fitting and public indexing.

comparisons.uncertaintyCaution: Exploratory journal-cluster intervals; no multiple-comparison correction.

notApplicableChecks.name: old-scope-baseline
notApplicableChecks.reason: The declared baseline is the previous corpus-trained model; all other applicable app thresholds are retained.

missingEvidence: No verified component ablation is available.
qualityGate.ablationStatus: Not evaluated by this expanded benchmark; no ablation evidence is claimed.
qualityGate.claim: Experimental only. These results do not establish broad superiority or production readiness.

privacy: Aggregate benchmark statistics only; no paper-level test identifiers, predictions, queries or abstracts.
limitations: Known publication venue is not acceptance probability or exclusive suitability.

New acquisition uses exact-ISSN journal matching in Europe PMC, records without an acquisition rights filter, English research/review papers, and newest-first bounded period prefixes (all-active-catalog, 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-24, annual windows, up to 1000 per journal per window, inactive titles excluded; untrained-catalog, 2021-01-01 to 2026-11-24, annual windows, up to 1000 per journal per window, inactive titles included; general-multidisciplinary, 2024-01-01 to 2026-11-24, monthly windows, up to 150 per journal per window, inactive titles excluded; identity-corrections, 2011-01-01 to 2026-11-24, annual windows, up to 500 per journal per window, inactive titles included). Passes may overlap; records are deduplicated before frozen membership. Pass caps are not unique-paper counts or training caps. Period prefixes are not random or exhaustive for high-volume journals.

The untouched holdout measures newly unseen papers within this bounded all-rights acquisition universe, not all publication output. Holdout membership is frozen before development reuse-rights filtering; acquisition eligibility still limits the evaluated population.
The older varied-license corpus was previously seen; historical test results are regression-only, never main metrics or readiness evidence.
OA status and authorship alone are not training or redistribution permission; documentary reuse rights are checked separately.
Adapter reuse-documentation checks cover public-index citations only; omitted training citations are not re-audited here.
Temporal cutoffs differ by journal; frozen encoder pretraining overlap is unknown.
This adapter checks recorded artifacts and memberships; it does not rerun or independently reproduce evaluation.

Retained historical sources include the original bounded varied-license corpus and the prior expanded OPEN_ACCESS:Y acquisition: English research/review papers, up to 1000 newest papers per journal per year in 2021-2026. These are earlier source protocols, not the new acquisition settings.

Eligible licensed historical training records remain in the fitting pool. New acquisition extends rather than replaces that pool; earlier validation, test and quarantined components remain excluded from development.

The acquisition query excludes indexed Editorial, Letter, Comment, Published Erratum, Retracted Publication, Retraction of Publication, Preprint and Expression of Concern types. Research is a broad bibliographic class, not an independently verified original-research assessment.

independentJournalEvaluation.context: Historical publication-label experiment, not acceptance probability or exclusive suitability. Same frozen papers for both models; unsupported targets, missing predictions and abstentions count as misses. Per-journal intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Recorded aggregates are checked for consistency, not independently replayed.
